info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Compliance By Param1-spec
info.description: The Compliance Reporting Retrieval API provides access to compliance data specific to a given parameter. This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed compliance reports based on the identified parameter, facilitating informed decision-making for regulatory and risk management purposes. Typical consumers include financial institutions and compliance officers looking to ensure adherence to regulations. By using this API, organizations can streamline their compliance reporting processes and enhance visibility into their compliance status.

get.description: Fetches a specific compliance report using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows users to obtain detailed information related to the selected compliance report, aiding in analysis and decision-making.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving compliance reporting data for the specified resource. It must be a valid JSON object that adheres to the defined schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the compliance report data is returned.

GetComplianceByParam1Request.title: Compliance Reporting Request Body
GetComplianceByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the compliance reporting operation in JSON format. It is expected to contain a string that specifies details related to the compliance request.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: An identifier for the endpoint being accessed. This is useful for tracing and logging the specific endpoint involved in the request.
